I am an old man, 72 years now, and I have farmed this land my whole life without ever going to school. This small plot of beans, just a small piece near the house, I keep for my family to eat. Beans do not need the chemical fertilizer like maize does — they find their own food from the soil, so I will not waste my coupon on this plot, I save that for my maize. I will put a little manure from the goats if I have some, plant the seeds I kept from last harvest, and my wife and grandchildren will help me weed. At my age I cannot hire people, and there is no river close to carry water here in Mangochi for this plot.
